issues.title: Root row chevron edge clipping
issues.description: The collapse chevron on the root layer row lacks sufficient left inset padding, placing it flush against the left panel boundary.
issues.evidence: The chevron icon preceding 'Checkout page' touches the outer left border of the layers panel.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent left padding (e.g., 8px) to root level tree rows.
issues.triageNote: Real: depth-0 rows render a zero-width spacer so the caret slot starts at x=0, leaving the ▾ glyph ~5px from the panel border; fixed by adding a ps-2 (8px, logical) start inset to depth-0 rows.

issues.title: Misaligned sibling row items
issues.description: Rows with expand chevrons shift icons and text labels to the right compared to non-expandable sibling rows.
issues.evidence: In the layers panel and children list, 'trust-badges' is offset relative to sibling rows 'headline' and 'product-shot'.
issues.suggestion: Reserve a fixed-width slot for the expander chevron across all tree rows.
issues.triageNote: The caret slot (`flex w-5 flex-none`) is rendered unconditionally on every row — only the glyph inside toggles hidden/inline — so siblings at equal depth are structurally pixel-aligned (fixed 20px caret slot + 20px glyph slot); the auditor read the presence/absence of the ▸ glyph as an offset.
